title: Southern Hospitality In Spades!
description:
My husband & I are excited about our town & love to share with people!  Our space is a basement suite with it's own entrance. The space has 2 great beds! One is a queen mattress, the other a king. A large fenced yard along with crate are available for your pets use.

The space
It's huge, especially for the price! Your 1 bathroom is accessed through the bedroom.

Guest access
There is a new mini fridge & microwave in the suite! Parking adequate for a U-Haul & trailer.

During your stay
I love interacting with our guests! But am definitely not pushy. I let my guests set the tone.

Other things to note
My husband, Paul & I live on the top floor of home.  We try to be really quiet & respectful of our guests, but it is a lived in home. ;-) We  adopted 2 kittens that are now large cats (a Maine Coon mix) & they do get the zoomies sometimes. Most people report they never hear them but a few do.  The same is true for the human noises.

We have been hosting for almost 9 years & love it! We’ve met great people from over 20 countries & all over the U.S. 
My husband Paul & I have been in this house for 12 years & it’s perfect for us. We back up to land that will never be built on & its a corner lot. Lots of wildlife outside our door... deer, raccoons, fox, coyotes, owls, wild turkeys,,, & only a 15 minute drive to Lower Broadway. It is NOT walkable to resteraunts or shopping.
